_doc: Authored attribution for MuckRock releases: request_id -> the Flock org (registry flock_names spelling) that answered the request, i.e. whose audit export this is. Wins over filename / own-search inference. 'audit' overrides the file-shape classification where the request itself says what was asked for. Source for each: the MuckRock request (agency + title) in catalog_requests.json. A request can also carry 'files': {<zip member path, member or file name, or container file name>: {org, audit, source}} for a file that is not the answering agency's own log; a file entry wins over the request entry field by field, and its 'source' states the evidence. 'source' is loaded into truth.releases.producer_source.

188086.source: MuckRock 188086, Pasadena Police Department (jurisdiction Pasadena, CA)

SAMPLES/Denver_ALPR_Network_Searches_1.x.source: MuckRock 188086 (Pasadena PD) production OneDrive_1_10-10-2025.zip, folder SAMPLES: a file named 'Denver_ALPR_Network_Searches_1.xlsx', not a Pasadena log. Checked 2026-09-25 on this release only: 0 of its 1,000,000 rows have Org Name 'Pasadena CA PD', and its rows are searches by many orgs (a network audit). Attributed on the file name to the registry's Denver entry (flock_names 'Denver Police Department'; the export spells the org 'Denver CO PD'). Not verifiable by Flock search UUID: the file has no ID column. Not a native Flock export: 6 columns (Org Name, Total Networks Searched, Total Devices Searched, Search Time, Search Type, Reason), Search Time formatted M/D/YYYY.
